## Style

Use   two spaces.
Prefer small functions.

## Commands

- Test: `npm run test`
- Lint: `npm run lint`

## Claude only

Entry point `src/main.ts` (also known as `main.ts`), docs in `docs/`, secrets in `.env`.
Links: https://example.com, `https://example.com/x.md`, `/abs/path`, `<placeholder>/x.md`, `*.md`.
The old entry point was `src/old.ts`.
Read [the guide](docs/guide.md) and [gone](docs/gone.md).
